description:
Cast Saw in Half by paying {2}{B}, destroying Spark Double and creating two token copies of it that are nonlegendary copies of Kairi.
When Spark Double dies, it triggers.
Holding priority, cast Culling the Weak by paying {B} and sacrificing one of the Spark Double tokens.
When the token dies, it triggers. Choose either mode.
Resolve Culling the Weak, adding {B}{B}{B}{B}.
Resolve the Spark Double trigger from step 5, causing you to mill six cards and return Saw in Half and Culling the Weak from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat
